recentItems.title: CMవిజయ్ ప్రభుత్వం కూలిపోతుందా? | Will CM Thalapathy Vijay government collapse in Tamil Nadu
recentItems.description:
Tamil Nadu politics is facing intense turmoil as rumors swirl around the potential collapse of Chief Minister Thalapathy Vijay’s TVK coalition government just six months into power. With DMK leaders claiming that 60 to 70 TVK MLAs are dissatisfied and MK Stalin hinting at an imminent regime change, Vijay has stepped in to steady his alliance amidst friction with Congress ministers and alleged poaching attempts. While welfare initiatives like free express bus travel for women and expanded school breakfast schemes have earned public praise, rising law-and-order concerns, price hikes, and scandals involving party MLAs are severely testing Vijay's "clean governance" image. Watch this complete breakdown of the Chennai political crisis, the ideological clash between TVK and DMK, and whether CM Vijay can survive this major litmus test.

recentItems.title: పసి మనసుల్లో ఇన్ని బాధలా..? పిల్లలపై ఒత్తిడికి కారణాలేంటి..? || Neralu Ghoralu
recentItems.description:
Childhood is meant to be a time of learning, friendship, play and carefree moments. But increasing concerns over stress among young students raise serious questions about the emotional and psychological pressures children may be experiencing. Even at the age of 10 or 12, some children may be silently struggling with expectations, academic pressure, family circumstances and feelings they find difficult to express.

Why are children facing such overwhelming stress at an early age? What pressures are affecting their mental well-being? Why are some young students reaching a point of despair and considering suicide? This special report explores the hidden emotional struggles of children and highlights the need for parents, teachers and society to listen, understand and provide timely support. Every child's feelings deserve attention, care and compassion.

recentItems.description:
Visakhapatnam is poised for a major transformation, with the Andhra Pradesh government preparing an ambitious development roadmap to make it a leading economic and industrial hub on India's eastern coast. The vision includes building an IT ecosystem on the lines of Cyberabad, establishing global-scale manufacturing facilities and developing an international logistics gateway.

The proposed Visakha Economic Region aims to bring together nine districts and seven major sectors by 2047. Initiatives such as Bay-Tech City and Vizag 2.0 are expected to shape a new development model for the region. The plan focuses on expanding industrial activity, strengthening infrastructure, attracting investments and creating employment opportunities. Which sectors are central to this vision? What role could they play in Andhra Pradesh's economic growth? Take a closer look at the government's ambitious roadmap for Visakhapatnam.

recentItems.description:
India and Nepal have taken steps to further strengthen their longstanding friendship through a series of key bilateral agreements. During Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit to India, he met Prime Minister Narendra Modi, with both sides discussing ways to deepen cooperation and reinforce bilateral relations.

The visit assumes importance against the backdrop of recent strains in India-Nepal relations over border issues and China's efforts to expand its influence in Nepal. The agreements between the two neighbouring countries raise important questions about regional cooperation, strategic interests and the future of their partnership. What is the significance of these agreements? How should Nepal's diplomatic outreach to India be viewed amid China's growing regional presence? An in-depth look in this edition of Idi Sangati.
